# HandyGirl Organizers

> Professional organizing services in Los Angeles specializing in home and business decluttering, space transformation, and home staging.

HandyGirl Organizers is a Los Angeles-based professional organizing company led by experienced organizers including Kathy R. and Cyndi Seidler. They provide comprehensive organizing solutions for residential and commercial clients, from clutter removal to home staging and business office organization.

- Home organization
- Decluttering
- Office organization

## Core Services

- [Professional Organizer Services](https://handygirl.com/professional-organizer-services): HandyGirl professional organizing services overview and offerings
- [Clutter Sweep](https://handygirl.com/professional-organizer-services/clutter-removal): Clutter Sweep service - professional clutter removal and organization
- [Organize Home Office](https://handygirl.com/professional-organizer-services/organize-home-office): Home office organization service - paper management and productivity
- [Room Makeovers](https://handygirl.com/professional-organizer-services/room-makeovers): Room makeover service - transform cluttered spaces into organized rooms
- [Business Organization](https://handygirl.com/professional-organizer-services/business-organization): Business office organizing - document management and productivity solutions
- [Home Staging Services](https://handygirl.com/professional-organizer-services/home-staging-services): Home staging services - prepare homes for sale with professional organizing
